auditScope: Local W5 evidence review after a real scheduled docked-stop change; not a claim of independent or human review.

issues.title: Bus art remains one tier below the target
issues.detail: Slab side panels, block-like wheels and simple door treatment retain a game-prop appearance.

issues.title: Docked night-stop remains visually unpolished
issues.detail: The real bus now dwells with open doors but the composition and sparse surroundings do not sell a boarding moment.

issues.title: Shadow acceptance remains unproven
issues.detail: W5 preserves the W4 budget-safe shadow configuration and does not establish full shadow coverage.

issues.title: Fixture remains sparse
issues.detail: Routes are legible, but empty green blocks and foliage dominate city context.

issues.title: Tram remains absent
issues.detail: No rail, articulated vehicle, catenary or platforms are present.

strengths: 16 standard and 10 directed captures are ready with zero errors.
The docked bus is a real, route-table scheduled vehicle.
summary: 6.8 FAIL. W5 repairs the evidence gap for a docked night stop but does not meet the visual standard for a higher score.
